headline: A 2020 executive order that, based on its title, targets payments to drug-pricing middlemen in order to lower what patients pay.
what_it_does: No official summary was provided, so this is based only on the title. The title says the order aims to lower prices for patients by ending what it calls kickbacks paid to middlemen. In prescription drug pricing, middlemen usually means companies that negotiate drug deals between drug makers and insurance plans. The specific rules, programs, and agencies involved cannot be confirmed from the title alone.

who_it_affects.group: Patients who pay for prescription drugs
who_it_affects.how: The order's stated goal is to lower the prices these patients pay.

who_it_affects.group: Companies that act as middlemen in drug pricing
who_it_affects.how: The title suggests payments these companies receive could be limited or ended.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed July 24, 2020; any specific deadlines are not stated in the source material.
